mechanism_of_action.plain_language: No sufficiently verified public description of the biological target or mechanism for [177Lu]Lu-NNS309 was identified from established sources. As a lutetium-177 radiopharmaceutical, its intended antitumor effect would generally depend on target-directed delivery of beta radiation, but the specific targeting moiety for NNS309 could not be confirmed.
